title: Mediterranean Pasta Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious pasta dish inspired by the Mediterranean diet, featuring a mix of herbs and vegetables.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped herbs and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the diced bell peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced cucumber and cherry tomatoes, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet.
Toss the pasta with the herb and vegetable mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with crumbled feta cheese if desired.
